name: Duong cha la
summary: Đuông chà là is the fat, white grub taken from the trunk of the chà là palm, eaten with nước mắm. Not everyone will try it.
where: The cape countryside, when it is offered.
seoDescription: Đuông chà là is the fat, white palm grub of the Cà Mau countryside, eaten with nước mắm. Not everyone will want it.
